hero.lead: Sports hubs in communities, futsal inside the school and training for the people who teach. AIDEP builds what makes sport arrive — and stay.

about.title: Structure, so sport reaches where it has not yet.
paragraphs: AIDEP is a non-profit association that runs sports projects: it sets up hubs in communities, brings futsal into schools and trains the people who work with sport.
Nothing here is a one-off. Every project arrives with staff, equipment, a calendar and published accounts — that is what keeps the activity going after opening day.
The association currently works across Brazil, and its statute provides for international reach.

projects.title: The same work, along different routes.
projects.description: The community, the school and the training of those who teach: each project meets the same person at a different point in their life.

approach.title: From the sports hub to the discussion table.
approach.description: The work of AIDEP starts in the community and organises itself all the way up to the institutions that shape the future of sport.

sport.title: Tools, not ends.
paragraphs: Sport is not the destination. It is how training, belonging and opportunity happen — in the community, in the school and in the places where knowledge is shared.
Sport and para-sport sit together in the association’s name because they sit together in practice: the same structure, the same equipment and the same technical standard for everyone.

items.question: Where does my donation go?
items.answer: To the projects of the association: the Coração Valente Social Project, Futsal na Escola and FutEdu Summit. The funds sustain sports hubs, the presence of sport in schools and the training activities.

items.question: Does AIDEP account for what it receives?
items.answer: Yes. Accountability is prepared every month and published on the Transparency page, together with reports and institutional documents.

items.question: Who is served by the projects?
items.answer: Children, teenagers, young people, adults and communities in situations of vulnerability. More than 40 thousand people have already been reached.

items.question: Where does AIDEP operate?
items.answer: Across the whole Brazilian territory. The statute of the association also provides for international operation.

items.question: How can I donate right now?
items.answer: The official donation channels have not been released yet. Write to the association and the team will point out how to contribute.

items.question: Can my company support AIDEP?
items.answer: Yes. AIDEP maintains partnerships with public and private institutions. Use the partnership form to start the conversation.
